claims: Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor respiratory status closely.
Continue vasopressor or hemodynamic support as needed and monitor arterial blood pressure closely.
Continue fentanyl and propofol infusions for sedation and analgesia, titrating to goal RASS -1.
Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess acid-base status and lactate clearance.
Monitor serum lactate trend to assess tissue perfusion and response to resuscitation.
Continue intravenous calcium gluconate and magnesium sulfate replacement for hypocalcemia and hypomagnesemia.
Administer sodium bicarbonate for severe metabolic acidosis if pH remains below 7.20, per clinical judgment.
Monitor platelet count and coagulation parameters given thrombocytopenia and elevated INR/PTT.
Monitor liver function tests and bilirubin given cholestatic pattern and coagulopathy.
Perform daily sedation interruption and spontaneous breathing trial assessment when clinically appropriate.
